<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914855_theRebbe_522" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914855_theRebbe_522__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>At the giving of the Torah, through the utterance "Anochi Hashem Elokecha," the aspect of "Anochi" above His drawing down into Havayah became the life-force of every Jew, and this is revealed through the mitzvah of teshuvah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And the reason for this,</t>
    <t s="2">is that at the giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="3">through the speech</t>
    <t s="4">"Anochi Havayah Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="5">it was thus brought about in each and every Jew,</t>
    <t s="6">that "Anochi"</t>
    <t s="7">(through being drawn into Havayah)</t>
    <t s="8">is "Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="9">your strength and your life-force.</t>
    <t s="10">And although this that "Anochi" becomes "Elokecha" is like it is drawn into Havayah,</t>
    <t s="11">and as explained in the maamar</t>
    <t s="12">[regarding] the distinction between the mitzvah of teshuvah and all the mitzvot,</t>
    <t s="13">that regarding teshuvah it is written "asher Anochi metzavecha,"</t>
    <t s="14">"Anochi" without qualification,</t>
    <t s="15">and regarding all the mitzvot it is written "Anochi Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="16">"Anochi" as it is drawn into Havayah,</t>
    <t s="17">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="18">based on what is known</t>
    <t s="19">that in the utterance "Anochi" all the mitzvot are included,</t>
    <t s="20">also the mitzvah of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="21">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="22">that in "Anochi Havayah"</t>
    <t s="23">(which was at the giving of the Torah)</t>
    <t s="24">is also included the aspect of "Anochi" as it is in His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="25">above the drawing down into Havayah,</t>
    <t s="26">except that the revelation of this aspect is in the mitzvah of teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="27">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="28">that this which at the giving of the Torah it was brought about in each and every Jew that "Anochi" is "Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="29">your strength and your life-force,</t>
    <t s="30">is also the aspect of "Anochi" that is above the drawing down into Havayah.</t>
    <t s="31">And when a person wishes to awaken in teshuvah</t>
    <t s="32">(even before he actually does teshuvah),</t>
    <t s="33">through this there is revealed to him that "Anochi"</t>
    <t s="34">(also the "Anochi" that is above the drawing down into Havayah)</t>
    <t s="35">is your strength and your life-force,</t>
    <t s="36">meaning that this also pertains to his Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah,</t>
    <t s="37">and through this,</t>
    <t s="38">this mitzvah</t>
    <t s="39">(teshuvah)</t>
    <t s="40">"which Anochi commands you,"</t>
    <t s="41">"is not wondrous from you nor is it distant,"</t>
    <t s="42">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="43">"the matter is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart to do it,"</t>
    <t s="44">for it is very near to each Jew to attain teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="45">and not only the level of teshuvah that has descended to be in the category of wonder and distance, but also the level of teshuvah of "which Anochi commands you."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The phrase "and you and your sons shall live on the leftover" means that through teshuvah, the inner powers of the soul receive life from the encompassing light, including the distant encompassing light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is "and you and your sons shall live on the leftover,"</t>
    <t s="3">that also the inner powers of the soul live on the leftover,</t>
    <t s="4">for although the leftover is a makif (encompassing light),</t>
    <t s="5">and moreover it is the distant makif,</t>
    <t s="6">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="7">life-force is drawn from it also to the inner powers of the soul,</t>
    <t s="8">because through teshuvah it is revealed that "Anochi" is "Elokecha," your strength and your life-force.</t>
    <t s="9">And in the manner explained above</t>
    <t s="10">(section 9)</t>
    <t s="11">regarding the matter of "it is not wondrous from you."</t>
    <t s="12">Except that the matter of "it is not wondrous from you" is that the inner powers of the soul</t>
    <t s="13">(through the desire to do teshuvah)</t>
    <t s="14">are in a manner that through them one can reach the encompassing lights,</t>
    <t s="15">and the matter of "and you and your sons shall live on the leftover" is that the inner powers live</t>
    <t s="16">(with inner vitality)</t>
    <t s="17">in the leftover that is drawn through teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="18">in the leftover of the close encompassing light and also in the leftover of the distant encompassing light</t>
    <t s="19">[and it can be said,</t>
    <t s="20">that in the leftover is also included the very Essence that is above the definition of encompassing and inner].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This concept connects to the future resurrection of the dead, where the body will receive life from the encompassing light, and thus teshuvah is linked to the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one can connect this also with the explanation of our Rabbis, of blessed memory, on the verse "and you and your sons shall live on the leftover,"</t>
    <t s="1">until the dead will live,</t>
    <t s="2">for in the resurrection of the dead the life of the body will be from the Sovev (the Surrounding Light)</t>
    <t s="3">(leftover).</t>
    <t s="4">And through the matter of "and you and your sons shall live on the leftover,"</t>
    <t s="5">that the life-force of the inner powers</t>
    <t s="6">(of the soul)</t>
    <t s="7">is in the leftover,</t>
    <t s="8">in the future there will also be life of the body from the Sovev.</t>
    <t s="9">[And moreover, the life of the body will be more elevated,</t>
    <t s="10">therefore,</t>
    <t s="11">the soul will be nourished from the body].</t>
    <t s="12">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="13">that this is also the connection of teshuvah to the future redemption,</t>
    <t s="14">for Israel are only redeemed through teshuvah</t>
    <t s="15">and Mashiach comes to bring the righteous back in teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="16">for the drawing down that comes through teshuvah is in a manner that from it life-force is drawn also to the inner powers,</t>
    <t s="17">"and you and your sons shall live on the leftover,"</t>
    <t s="18">and the perfection of the future redemption is in the resurrection of the dead,</t>
    <t s="19">that the life of the body will be from the Sovev.</t>
    <t s="20">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="21">through Israel doing teshuvah they are immediately redeemed,</t>
    <t s="22">with the true and complete redemption through our righteous Mashiach,</t>
    <t s="23">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="24">speedily in our actual time.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
